integrity: Microscopic generator and all proof steps are stated; executable reproduction uses only the Python standard library. The stated primary source predates the later arXiv upload.
scientific_limitations: Each asymptotic coefficient is for fixed finite length and fixed positive injection/extraction rates as resetting tends to infinity. The geometric coefficient grows with length; no simultaneous thermodynamic-limit assertion or independent priority certification. Computational tests are finite checks and not proof.
title: Geometric strong-reset boundary layer and universal throughput in open exclusion
